strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yego. Buri gikoresho niubuntu, nta kimenyetso cy'iyamamaza kandi nta cyugarijwe n'ubwishyu. Nta karita y'inguzanyo isabwa.

strings.privacy.title: Ibanga ry'amakuru
strings.privacy.description: Uko pdffusion yitwarira dosiye zawe: nta konti, nta nyandiko ibikwa, nta kwamamaza cyangwa kugurisha amakuru.
strings.privacy.intro: pdffusion yakozwe mu buryo bw'uko inyandiko zawe ziguma ari izawe. Dore mu magambo yoroheje ibiba igihe uyikoresha.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Dosiye zawe
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Zoherezwa zifungishijwe umutekano (HTTPS), zitunganywa mu buryo bwihuse, hanyuma zisibwa ako kanya nyuma y'uko ibyavuyemo byiteguye. Dosiye nini zicungwa mu buryo bw'igihe gito munsi y'izina ryihishe kandi zisibwa vuba nyuma y'uko zitunganywa; isukurwa ryihuse risiba buri kintu cyose cyashobora gusigara mu gihe cy'amasaha 24 byibura.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Nta konti, nta makuru bwite
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdffusion ntisaba kwiyandikisha, nta aderesi ya imeri cyangwa ikarita y'inguzanyo isabwa. Inyandiko zawe ntisomwa, ntizusesengurwa, ntizisangizwa cyangwa ngo zikoreshwe mu myitozo y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Gupima abasura urubuga
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tubara abasura urubuga mu buryo bwihishe kandi nta kokisi (Vercel Web Analytics) kugira ngo tumenye ibikoresho bifite akamaro. Nta kwamamaza cyangwa gukurikirana hagati y'imbuga.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kokisi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kokisi imwe yonyine, ishobora gukoreshwa cyangwa itagomba: yibuka ururimi wahisemo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kwakira urubuga
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Urubuga rwakirwa na Vercel kuri seriveri zo i Paris; guhindura Word, Excel na PowerPoint bikorerwa kuri Render i Frankfurt. Aba batanga serivisi bitaho gusa kuri dosiye mu gihe cyo guhindura.

strings.legal.terms.title: Amabwiriza y'imikoreshereze
strings.legal.terms.description: pdffusion ni ubuntu kuri bose, harimo n'ibigo n'inzego za Leta. Dosiye zawe ziguma ari izewe: nta na kimwe cyasesengurwa cyangwa ngo kibikwe.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Aya mabwiriza agenga imikoreshereze yawe ya pdffusion. Ni magufi ku bushake kandi yanditse mu rurimi rworoshye. Mu gukoresha uru rubuga, uba wemeye aya mabwiriza.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Uwasohoye pdffusion
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdffusion yateguwe, yubakwa kandi isohorwa na Mikailou Cedric Toure, umuhanga mu ikoranabuhanga ubarizwa i New Brunswick, muri Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Uruhushya rwo gukoresha rw'ubuntu, kuri bose
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdffusion ni ubuntu, nta kwiyandikisha kandi nta gihe ntarengwa, kuri buri wese: abantu ku giti cyabo, abanyeshuri, abarimu, ibigo, imiryango itari iya Leta, ubutegetsi bwite bwa Leta na za Guverinoma, muri Canada no mu bindi bihugu byose. Nta gice cyagenewe gusa abishyura, kuko nta gihari. Dosiye utunganya ziba izewe rwose: nta kimenyetso cy'uburenganzira (watermark) cyangwa icyavugo cya pdffusion ziba zifite.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Dosiye zawe zose, ndetse n'izibereye ibanga
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Ushobora gutunganya ubwoko bwose bwa dosiye, harimo n'izibereye ibanga, kuko pdffusion idasoma, ngo isesengure, ngo ibike cyangwa ngo isangize dosiye zawe: zitunganywa mu buryo bwikora hanyuma zigahita zisibwa. Uguma ari nyirazo, kandi ufite inshingano yo kugira uburenganzira bukenewe bwo kuzitunganya.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Inkomoko y'ibirimo no kwishyiriraho ku maseva yawe
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Inkomoko y'ibirimo bya pdffusion yasohowe munsi y'uruhushya rwa MIT. Ushobora kuyisoma, kuyisuzuma, kuyishyira ku maseva yawe bwite (harimo n'ahatagira interineti), kuyihindura no kuyisaranganya ku buntu, igihe cyose wubahiriza kumenyekanisha uburenganzira bwa nyirayo n'inyandiko y'uruhushya.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Imikoreshereze yemewe
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Ntushobora gukoresha pdffusion mu bikorwa bitemewe n'amategeko, kugerageza guhungabanya serivisi (kohereza dosiye nyinshi mu buryo bwikora, kugerageza kwinjira ku ngufu) cyangwa kunyura ku mipaka yayo y'ikoranabuhanga. Ingano n'umubare wa dosiye birinda serivisi kuri bose.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Kuboneka
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdffusion itangwa ku buntu. Ishobora guhinduka, guhagarikwa kugira ngo ivugururwe cyangwa igahagarikwa burundu. Buri gihe jya ubika dosiye zawe z'umwimerere: pdffusion ntibika kopi yazo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Garanti n'Inshingano
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Serivisi itangwa “uko iri”, nta garanti y'ubwoko bwose. Ku rwego rwinshi rwemewe n'amategeko, uwashohoye ntiyirengera ibyangiritse bitaziguye, gutakaza amakuru cyangwa ibyavuyemo bitatunganye neza. Reba dosiye utunganyije mbere yo kuzikoresha mu kintu cyose cy'ingenzi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Umutunga w'ubwenge
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Izina rya pdffusion, ikimenyetso cyayo n'inyandiko zo ku rubuga niiby'uwashohoye; kode iri munsi y'uruhushya rwa MIT nk'uko byavuzwe haruguru. Ibirango byavuzwe (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) ni iby'ababyiteho bwite.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Amategeko agenga
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Aya mabwiriza agengwa n'amategeko y'Intara ya New Brunswick n'amategeko ya Leta ya Canada akurikizwa muriyo. Inkiko za New Brunswick zifite ububasha, hatabangamiwe uburenganzira amategeko y'igugu cyawe aguha nk'umuguzi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].title: Impinduka
strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Aya mabwiriza ashobora kuvugururwa. Italiki iri hejuru ku rupapuro yerekana verisiyo iri mu bikorwa; impinduka ikurikizwa gusa ku mikoreshereze nyuma yaho isomewe.

strings.legal.terms.sections[10].text: Ufite ikibazo kuri aya mabwiriza? Twandikire ku rupapuro rw'umushinga:
strings.legal.security.title: Umutekano n'amakuru
strings.legal.security.description: Ibibera kuri dosiye zawe kuri pdffusion: gutunganywa mu buryo bwikora, nta isesengura, gusibwa ako kanya, ubutaka bw'ibanga, gucumbikirwa mu Burayi, n'uburyo bwo kuyishyira ku maseva yawe.
strings.legal.security.intro: Ibibera kuri dosiye zawe, aho zitunganyirizwa n'uburyo zirindwa: byasobanuwe mu buryo bworoshye, ku bantu ku giti cyabo n'abashinzwe ikoranabuhanga.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Nta dosiye zibikwa
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Dosiye zawe zitunganywa mu buryo bwikora, hanyuma zigahita zisibwa iyo ibyavuyemo byiteguye cyangwa bikuweho. Nta kopi ihari, nta bubiko bw'inyuma (backup) kandi nta mateka ahari. Isuku ikorwa buri munsi na yo isiba dosiye iyo ari yo yose y'agateganyo ishobora kuba yasigaye, bitarenze umunsi ukurikira.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Nta sesengura
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Nta n'umwe usoma dosiye zawe. Ntizisobanurwa, ntizisesengurwa, ntizisangizwa abandi cyangwa ngo zikoreshwe mu myitozo y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano (AI). pdffusion nta konti igira, nta kwamamariza bifite kandi nta mbuga zigenzura abakoresha.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ubutaka bw'ibanga (Encryption)
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Buri guhuza kurarindwa (HTTPS) kandi urubuga rutegeka ubutaka bw'ibanga kuri buri gusura (HSTS). Igikoresho cyo kurinda kirinda aba-PDF bawe na AES-256; ijambo ry'ibanga wahisemo ntirigeze ribikwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Aho dosiye zawe zitunganyirizwa
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Urubuga, ibikoresho bya PDF n'amafoto: Vercel, ikigo gicumbikira amakuru cya Paris (Fransa, Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi). Guhindura Word, Excel na PowerPoint: Render, i Frankfurt (Ubudage, Umuryango w'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi). Dosiye zirenze MB 4: ububiko bw'agateganyo bwa Vercel Blob, bwinshi bwitiriwe izina ritazwi, zisibwa nyuma yo gukoreshwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Uburinzi bw'ikoranabuhanga
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Imbonankubone z'umutekano (HSTS, kubuza urubuga kwinjizwa mu zindi mpapuro, kurinda urujijo rw'ubwoko bwa dosiye), aderesi za dosiye z'agateganyo zitamenyekana, na serivisi yo guhindura yakira gusa ubusabe bufite ikimenyetso cy'ibanga. Impinduka zose za kode zisuzumwa mu buryo bwikora (igerageza, isuzuma ry'ubwoko) mbere yo gusohoka.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Ubuzima bwite n'amategeko akurikizwa
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdffusion isohorerwa i New Brunswick kandi yubahiriza Itegeko rya Canada ryerekeye Kurinda Amakuru y'Umuntu n'Ubucuruzi bw'Ikoranabuhanga (PIPEDA). Ntiteranya amakuru y'umuntu ku giti cye yerekeye abayikoresha: nta konti, nta aderesi ya imeyili, nta kimenyetso cyo gukurikirana (cookie). Yubatswe ku mahame amwe n'ay'Ubumwe bw'Uburayi GDPR n'Itegeko 25 rya Québec: kugabanya amakuru, kutongera kuyakoresha, gusiba nyuma yo kuyatunganya.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Ku bigo bifite amabwiriza akomeye
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Niba amabwiriza yawe abuza kohereza dosiye kuri serivisi yo hanze, shyira pdffusion ku maseva yawe bwite. Porogaramu yuzuye ni iy'ubuntu, ifunguriwe bose kandi ikora nta interineti ihari: nta dosiye n'imwe isohoka mu rusobe rwawe rwa mudasipwa. Amabwiriza yo kuyishyiraho ari ku rupapuro rw'umushinga.

strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Inkomoko y'ibirimo byuzuye irafunguye: amakipe yawe y'umutekano ashobora kugenzura buri jambo muri aya.

strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Utekereza ko wabonye icyuho cy'umutekano? Bikumenyeshe mu ibanga rivuye ku gice cya “Umutekano” cy'urupapuro rw'umushinga:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Uburyo bwo kubigeraho
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Inyandiko y'uburyo bwo kugera kuri pdffusion: intego ya WCAG 2.2 urwego rwa AA, ingamba zafashwe, ibyo itageraho n'uburyo bwo kumenyekanisha ikibazo.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Buri wese agomba gushobora gukoresha pdffusion, harimo n'abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa babona buhoro, abatumva cyangwa bafite ubugufi bwo kumva, cyangwa abafite ubumuga bw'imyitozo ngororamubiri cyangwa ubwenge.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Intego y'urwego
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdffusion igamije guhuza n'Amabwiriza y'Uburyo bwo Kugera ku Biri ku Rubuga (WCAG) 2.2, urwego rwa AA, urwego mpuzamahanga rwa W3C. Urwego rwa AA rufata ibyo bisabwa n'Ibisabwa by'Urupapuro rw'Imigenzo ya Leta ya Canada ku Bugera ku Rubuga, urwego rw'Uburayi EN 301 549 n'Igika cya 508 muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika, zivuga kuri WCAG 2.0 cyangwa 2.1 urwego rwa AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Imiterere yo guhuza
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdffusion ihuye gake n'urwego rwa WCAG 2.2 rwa AA: ibyo itageraho bizwi biri munsi. Iyi nyandiko ishingiye ku isuzuma ry'imbere ryakozwe ku ya 2 Ukwakira 2026, hakoreshejwe ibikoresho bikora byonyine (axe, Lighthouse) n'isuzuma ry'intoki (urufunguzo, itandukanyirizo, gukuza, kumenyesha). Nta isuzuma ryigenga riratangira.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Ibyashyizweho
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Urubuga rwose rukoresha urufunguzo rw'agakoresho, rufite ihuza rya “Simbuka ujye ku bwiriza” n'umurongo ugaragara ku kintu cyose gikora. Itandukanyirizo ry'inyandiko riri nibura kuri 4.5:1. Intambwe z'igikorwa (kohereza, ibyavuyemo, ikosa) zimenyeshwa abasoma binyuze mu majwi. Urutonde rwa dosiye rushobora guhinduka hatabayeho kujyana no kurekura, hifashishijwe utubuto. Urubuga rukurikiza igenamiterere rya mudasipwa yawe ryo “kugabanya imyifatire”: amashusho ahita ahagarara burundu. Amapaji aracyasomeka ku gukuza kwa 400% no kuri terefone ngendanwa. Ururimi rwa buri rupapuro ruramenyekana, kandi icyarabu kigaragarizwa iburyo kugana ibumoso.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Ibyo itageraho bizwi
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Bitabaye icyo genamiterere, amashusho yo gushushanya (ibiranga inyuma, uruziga, umubare w'imiterere) akora adahagarara; umubare uhagarara gato iyo wicayeho cyangwa iyo wakandagije urufunguzo. Uruziga rushushanyije ku rupapuro rwa mbere rukoreshwa n'imbeba cyangwa urutoki; ni rwo rushushanya, kandi urutonde rw'imiterere rwerekana ruboneka kandi nk'umwandiko ku rupapuro. Indimi zahinduwe n'imashini zishobora kugira amakosa. Kandi se, ubushobozi bwo kugera kuri dosiye yatunganijwe bushingiye ku mwandiko w'umwimerere: pdffusion ntongeraho ibimenyetso byo kugerwaho kuri PDF idafite na kimwe.
